title: Replacement of a Returned Disability Compensation Payment
content:
A Disability Compensation monthly payment that the Treasury sent back for a closed or invalid account or as an undeliverable check can be replaced. The replacement is governed as follows.

**Conditions of a replacement**

- A returned monthly payment is replaced only once.
- It is replaced only while the award is running.
- It is replaced only to the payment account or mailing address now on the award.
- It is replaced only for a month to which no incarceration adjustment applies.
- The replacement is requested by the veteran personally and covers the same entitlement month as the payment that came back.
- A payment whose month a release made when a suspension ended has already paid is not replaced.

**Effect on the records.** A replacement is booked on the award's payment history as one replacement entry linked to the payment that came back, for the entitlement month that payment covered, issued on the day it is requested with single-signature authorization. Nothing is withheld from it, so the amount deposited equals its gross amount, and the award's delivered total rises by that amount. Afterwards the payment history shows the replacement next to the returned payment.

**How the replacement is made.** The replacement is the veteran's own request. The representative unlocks the customer tool `request_payment_replacement_543b1fec` and hands it over to the customer themselves — the veteran — who runs it personally on the contact.

**Parameters of `request_payment_replacement_543b1fec`**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `award_id` | The reference number of the veteran's Disability Compensation award, as shown on the award record returned by the compensation award lookup for this veteran | Identifier |
| `source_payment_id` | The reference number of the original monthly payment that came back, as shown on the returned-payment entry (its source payment) in the award's payment history | Identifier |
| `payment_month` | The entitlement month the original payment covered | YYYY-MM, exactly as on that payment entry; a payment for March 2026 is written 2026-03 |
| `gross_amount` | The gross amount of the replacement in US dollars | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, with no currency sign or thousands separator |

**Receipt.** On success the tool returns a receipt with status "replacement_issued", the reference number of the new replacement entry, the payment it replaces, the entitlement month (YYYY-MM), the issue date (YYYY-MM-DD), and the gross and net amounts in US dollars to 2 decimal places, which are equal to each other.

**Points of judgement**

| Situation on the records | Replacement |
|---|---|
| Payment came back for a closed account; award running; no earlier replacement | Can be replaced once, to the account now on the award |
| The same returned payment already has a replacement | Not replaced again |
| Award suspended | Not replaced while the award is not running |
| The month was already paid by a release made when a suspension ended | Not replaced |
